description: packs/session.json's format and rules (read its description), for the brief item kind (docs/MISSION_BRIEF.md §3): an edit whose every operation is on a brief (an item this session knows as one, or one an item.create earlier in the same edit makes) is taken in a read-only pack, where any other is refused as read_only; nextBatch sends the longest run of queued edits, from the oldest, that are all on briefs or all on anything else (MAX_BATCH at most), so the two never share a batch; and a pack that turns read-only (an event, 423 or 403 pack_read_only) drops what waits as it always has, except brief edits still queued, which stay to be sent. A port that has not reached briefs is held to session.json alone.

scenarios.name: a finished pack takes a brief edit and refuses any other as read_only
a viewer makes a brief and edits it
brief edits go in batches of their own, each run in the order made
a pack finished while brief and other edits wait keeps the brief edits and drops the rest

events.summary: Colin finished the pack. It is read-only for everyone.

scenarios.name: a batch refused with 423 is dropped, and a brief edit queued behind it stays to be sent
